tasks.short: Monitor follow-up and review compliance reports.

steps.what: List violations found and the follow-up date.
Monitor whether the follow-up actions closed the case.
Review the compliance monitoring report for that case.

tasks.design: Open violations are listed in {DOCS} with the date a follow-up action is due. The inspector monitors whether those actions closed the case and reviews the compliance monitoring report. A case with no due date is not listed as overdue. The list does not decide that the violation is closed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Follow-up lived in a notebook, and a monitoring report was read without the original finding.
tasks.enabler_now: Due dates already stored can be listed before the inspector reviews the case.
tasks.still_hard: An action that was done but did not fix the violation, and a report that cites the wrong case.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a completed action that leaves the violation in place.
tasks.altitude: Overdue cases are visible. The inspector still decides whether the follow-up closed the violation and still reviews the report. A due date is not a closure.

reach.task: Track a commitment to its due date and still judge whether it was met.
reach.learn: The date can be listed. The closure is still judged here.

evidence.claim: A stored due date can be listed. The list cannot decide that a follow-up action closed the violation.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Case id and due date, produced by the violation case. A case with no due date is not listed as overdue. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the case list the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which reports count as compliance monitoring.
Who may mark a case closed besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of cases have a stored due date?
Which closures need a second visit?

already_counted.description: The inspector still judges whether the follow-up closed the case.
The inspector still reviews the monitoring report.

incremental.description: The inspector chases a case whose due date was never stored.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of stored due dates. It disappears when the date is missing and the inspector reconstructs it. Judging closure and reviewing the report stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Examine permit conditions that cite a stored clause.

loop.purpose: Pull a permit condition only when the sentence cites a clause id already stored.
loop.output: A condition list with clause ids.
loop.check: Every line cites a clause id that exists in the permit.
loop.stop: A sentence with no clause id is left out.
loop.why_not_simpler: The condition is a sentence, so a template of typed fields cannot read it. The loop stops when the sentence has no clause id.

steps.what: Check the application records against those requirements.
Decide whether the license meets the licensing requirements.

tasks.design: Permit conditions are read in {DOCS} only when the sentence cites a clause id already stored. The inspector checks the application records against those requirements and decides whether the licence meets the licensing requirements. A sentence with no clause id is left for the inspector. The list does not grant the licence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Permits were read end to end on paper, and a condition from an old permit was treated as current.
tasks.enabler_now: A condition that cites a stored clause can be listed before the inspector reads the rest.
tasks.still_hard: A sentence condition with no clause id, and a record that meets the words but not the site.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a complete form that still misses what the permit requires.
tasks.altitude: Cited conditions are listed. The inspector still checks the records and still decides on the licence. An uncited sentence is not treated as a requirement.

reach.task: Match a line to a published measure and still decide the line that does not match.
reach.learn: The cited clause can be listed. The licence decision stays here.

evidence.claim: A permit sentence that cites a stored clause can be listed. The list cannot decide that an application meets the licensing requirements.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Permit id and clause id, produced by the permit. A sentence with no clause id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the permit store the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which licence types use sentence conditions.
Who signs the licence besides the inspector.
research_questions: What share of conditions cite a stored clause?

already_counted.description: The inspector still checks the records against the requirements.
The inspector still decides on the licence.

incremental.description: The inspector reads a sentence the list left out.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing conditions that already cite a clause. It disappears when the sentence has no clause id and the inspector reads the permit. The licence decision stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare the enforcement and custody report.

steps.what: Build the tabular figures the report will cite.
Write the summary, including the chain of custody.
Review the written report before it is filed.

tasks.design: Tabular figures already stored are built in {DOCS} for the report. The inspector writes the summary, including the chain of custody, and gives the oral account. A sentence may cite only a figure in the table. The table does not write the finding, and nothing is filed before the inspector reviews it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were written from loose readings, and a figure from another sample was cited.
tasks.enabler_now: Readings already stored can be placed in the table before the inspector writes.
tasks.still_hard: A custody break the table cannot describe, and an oral question the table does not answer.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell that a correct figure belongs to a sample that was not kept.
tasks.altitude: The table is ready. The inspector still writes the summary and the chain of custody and still gives the oral report. A figure that is not in the table is not cited.

reach.role: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
reach.task: Put stored figures in a report and still write what they mean.
reach.learn: The table can be built. The custody narrative stays here.

evidence.claim: Stored readings can be placed in a table. The table cannot write the summary or the chain of custody.
A record is filed only when the required ids are already stored. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a rule already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Sample id and reading value, produced by the sample record. A reading with no sample id is not put in the table. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the readings the organisation already stores.
unknowns: Which reports must also be given orally.
How long custody records are kept.
research_questions: What share of readings already have a sample id?

already_counted.description: The inspector still writes the summary and the chain of custody.
The inspector still reviews the written report.

incremental.description: The inspector adds a custody event the table did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the table of readings already stored. It disappears when a reading has no sample id and the inspector looks it up. Writing the summary and the chain of custody stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe field conditions and record readings.

steps.what: Observe field conditions and interpret the chemical levels.
Record a flow meter reading that has a meter id.
Report the field reading the inspector accepts.

tasks.design: The inspector observes the field conditions and interprets the chemical levels on site. A flow meter reading is recorded in {DOCS} only when the meter id and the value are both present. The inspector reports the reading that is accepted. A reading with no meter id is not stored as data.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings were written on a wet pad and typed later, sometimes against the wrong meter.
tasks.enabler_now: A reading that already has a meter id can be stored once.
tasks.still_hard: A level that does not match what the site looks like, and a meter with no id.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a plausible reading on a meter that is in the wrong place.
tasks.altitude: A numbered meter can be recorded once. The inspector still observes the field and still interprets the levels. An unnumbered reading stays on paper.

reach.task: Capture a meter value against a meter id and still read the place.
reach.learn: The value can be stored. The field interpretation stays here.

evidence.claim: A meter reading with a meter id can be stored once. It cannot observe the field or interpret a chemical level.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Meter id and reading value, produced by the meter note. A reading with no meter id is not stored. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the reading store the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which meters are in the register.
Who else may accept a field reading.
research_questions: What share of meters already have an id?
Which levels are always interpreted on site?

already_counted.description: The inspector still observes and interprets the field.
The inspector still reports the accepted reading.

incremental.description: The inspector identifies a meter the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is storing a reading that already has a meter id. It disappears when the meter has no id and the inspector writes it by hand. Observing and interpreting the field stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still judges whether a violation is closed and still writes the report. A due date, a permit field, and a stored reading can be ready before that work.
reach: Regulatory affairs specialists compare an application with a requirement that is already written, and this job learns the compare is not the licence decision.
Logistics engineers read a meter into a record, and this job learns the interpretation of the site stays with the person who was there.
skills_to_grow: Tell a complete permit field from a condition that is only a sentence.
Write a report that cites a figure already in the file.
role.ambitious_version: Due dates and stored readings are ready before the inspector writes, and the finding in the report is still that person’s.
